normalization.cumulative_flux: sum H daily values, require all H source-defined masks, divide residual by H times the frozen train/train daily field scale
normalization.terminal_stock: use the complete daily-operator state after day H and divide residual by the frozen train/train stock scale
normalization.macro: equal weight over named fields within a component and equal weight over 1, 7 and 30 day horizons
normalization.systematic_bias: square of the signed mean normalized residual; never replace with unsigned RMSE

existing_one_day_process_anchor.note: preserved separately so long-horizon improvement cannot erase one-day process supervision

coefficient_policy.required_preflight: one bounded gradient-norm and loss-magnitude calibration on train/train plus non-test validation only

terminal_stock_fields.teacher: next-state biomass carbon in source below-litter parts, weighted by pft_fraction

total live biomass + litter + particulate soil carbon + DOC + declared canopy/interception organic-carbon inventory
